correctness.rationale: The idempotent equations force e_x=(1/2,x/2), Q(x)=1. Their product target forces c=2Q(w), x+y=4w; after x=s/2+z,y=s/2-z the fiber is exactly Q(z)=1-4Q(w) in s-perp. Nonisotropic s yields nondegenerate (d-1)-space determinant D/Q(s); nonzero isotropic s yields q lifts of a (d-2)-space with determinant -D. Explicit all-odd-finite-field Gauss sums give the closed representation counts and prove the dimension-four support boundary and d3 missing q²-1 targets. Independent literal factor-pair enumeration checked every target for eighteen finite configurations.
